source: W10-A2 installable package (modules-ext/external-seo). Static rendering of the live manifest.mjs; matches the ProcessModuleManifest shape validated by validateProcessModuleManifest (definition + resourceIndex + handlerRefs + contract refs + runtimeCompatibilityRange). The module-shaped fields (identity/inputContract/outputContract/outcomes/flow/artifacts/policies/invariants/executionProfiles) are nested under `definition`, mirroring the live manifest.mjs which wraps `definition: externalSeoProcessModule`. Resource/handler digests are real sha256Hex values computed at load; they match the bytes shipped under schemas/ and resources/.

identity.name: external-seo
identity.description: Installable External-node package: fetches keyword ranking snapshots from an external SEO provider. Upgrades the W0-A7 synthetic fixture into a real package with a real adapter and node protocol.

outcomes.description: A ranking snapshot was fetched from the external SEO provider and content-addressed.

nodes.label: Fetch Ranking
nodes.description: Fetch current search-engine ranking for the campaign keywords from an external SEO provider and produce a content-addressed ranking snapshot.

artifacts.description: Content-addressed ranking snapshot envelope produced by the External node.

invariants.description: The fetch-ranking node must reference the exact versioned adapter seo-ranking-adapter@1.0.0; the runtime must resolve it through the ExternalAdapterRegistry and never through module-name lookup.
